packageArguments.name: --forms-dir

server.name: io.github.aoreshkov/oracle-forms-mcp
server.description: Serves Oracle Forms module content (.fmb/.mmb/.pll/.olb) from a directory to MCP clients.
server.title: Oracle Forms

packageArguments.description: Directory containing the Oracle Forms modules (in copy-mode, the pre-converted *_fmb.xml/*.pld files live here). Mount it into the container and point --forms-dir at the mount.
packageArguments.name: --forms-dir

packageArguments.description: Optional. Directory the converted XML / .pld text forms are written into — the converter runs with this as its working directory, one flat directory for all modules, each file named after its module (orders_fmb.xml, utils.pld). Mount a writable volume and point this at it to keep the text forms outside the cache. Must not be the forms directory. Also settable as OFMCP_CONVERTED_DIR.
packageArguments.name: --converted-dir

packageArguments.description: Optional. Site-supplied converter run instead of Oracle's frmf2xml: a whole command line with its arguments, quoting any part that contains spaces, or a JSON array of arguments. It is spawned directly, never through a shell; the module's path replaces {} and is appended when {} is absent, and the working directory is the converted directory (--converted-dir, else the module's cache directory), which is where it must write the text form. Mount the converter into the container and point this at it. Also settable as OFMCP_CONVERT_COMMAND.
packageArguments.name: --convert-command

environmentVariables.description: Same as --converted-dir, for clients that set environment variables rather than arguments. The flag wins when both are given.
environmentVariables.name: OFMCP_CONVERTED_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Same as --convert-command — the whole command line, not just an executable — for clients that set environment variables rather than arguments. The flag wins when both are given.
environmentVariables.name: OFMCP_CONVERT_COMMAND

runtimeRequirements.liveConversion: Converting binary .fmb/.pll in place needs an Oracle Forms installation (ORACLE_HOME) on the host; Oracle's frmf2xml/frmcmp tools are proprietary and are never bundled.
runtimeRequirements.mcpb: A JRE 21+ must be on PATH. MCPB manifests can only declare Node/Python runtimes, so this cannot be expressed in the bundle itself.
runtimeRequirements.oci: None — the image is self-contained, but it is copy-mode only: it serves modules that have already been converted to text (*_fmb.xml / *.pld) next to the modules in the mounted directory.

packageArguments.description: Optional. runtimeRequirements.liveConversion: Converting binary .fmb/.pll in place needs an Oracle Forms installation (ORACLE_HOME) on the host; Oracle's frmf2xml/frmcmp tools are proprietary and are never bundled.
runtimeRequirements.mcpb: A JRE 21+ must be on PATH. MCPB manifests can only declare Node/Python runtimes, so this cannot be expressed in the bundle itself.
runtimeRequirements.oci: None — the image is self-contained, but it is copy-mode only: it serves modules that have already been converted to text (*_fmb.xml / *.pld) next to the modules in the mounted directory.
